_note: The opposite case, and the one the attempt counter is right about: three review rounds on the same defect. Round 1 names it, rounds 2 and 3 re-find it after fixes that did not land it. Under the retired 3-attempt counter this bought a third fix attempt; under the convergence budget the second consecutive non-converging round spends the stop budget, so the loop stops having made TWO attempts.
